name: Redirect Lightning
clause: Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target. // As an additional cost to cast ~, pay 5 life or pay {2}.

needs.proposedSignature: AbilityCost: { exileSelf?: true; counters?: { counter: string, amount: number, who: 'you' | 'payer' } }  ·  additionalCosts: [{ choose: AbilityCost[] }]  ·  face field ward: { cost: AbilityCost }
needs.semantics: Three missing cost shapes met in this batch: exiling the source as an activation cost (only sacrificeSelf exists); getting counters (poison) as a cost, which a non-mana ward needs; and an additional cost that is a CHOICE between two costs. A `ward` declaration carrying a whole AbilityCost would also let the ward line be covered rather than hand-written as a triggered ability.
needs.clause: {1}{G}, Exile ~: … / Ward-Get five poison counters. / As an additional cost to cast ~, pay 5 life or pay {2}.

needs.proposedSignature: Effect: { op: 'change-target', target: { kind: 'spell-or-ability', singleTarget?: true }, to?: 'new-legal' }
needs.semantics: Change the target of a spell or ability on the stack that has a single target, the controller choosing a new legal target. The stack item already keeps targetsByEffect / targetParts, so this is a rewrite of one pick plus a legality re-check.
needs.clause: Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target.
